import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        String input = in.next();
        Pattern p = Pattern.compile("\\([\\w_]*\\)");
        Matcher m = p.matcher(input);
        int longest = 0;
        int last = 0;
        long inside = 0;
        while (m.find()) {
            longest = Math.max(longest, longestWords(input.substring(last, m.start())));
            inside += countWords(input.substring(m.start() + 1, m.end() - 1));
            last = m.end();
        }
        longest = Math.max(longest, longestWords(input.substring(last)));
        System.out.println(longest + " " + inside);
    }

    private static int longestWords(String s) {
        return Arrays.stream(s.split("_")).mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
    }

    private static long countWords(String s) {
        return Arrays.stream(s.split("_")).filter(x -> !x.isEmpty()).count();
    }
}

import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        String input = in.next();
        Pattern p = Pattern.compile("\\([\\w_]*\\)");
        String[] outside = input.split(p.pattern());
        int longest = 0;
        for (String seg : outside) {
            int currentMax = 0;
            StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(seg, "_");
            while (st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                currentMax = Math.max(currentMax, st.nextToken().length());
            }
            longest = Math.max(longest, currentMax);
        }
        long inside = 0;
        Matcher m = p.matcher(input);
        while (m.find()) {
            String inner = m.group().substring(1, m.group().length() - 1);
            inside += new StringTokenizer(inner, "_").countTokens();
        }
        System.out.println(longest + " " + inside);
    }
}
